description: Free, watermark-free screen recorder and live streaming tool for Windows
##: Main Windows build only; the vendor also ships an arm64 build and a legacy 4.2.4 XP build.
checkver matches the 'Windows <version>' label; the XP compatibility link uses a different label.
innosetup is required because 7-Zip cannot open this Inno Setup 5.5.7 archive; Scoop adds innounp automatically.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: no checksum is published, so Excavator downloads the 40 MB installer to compute it.
